description:
"I can't get an erection."   

Those were the blunt words uttered by my ex-boyfriend, Kim Do-jun, who suddenly reappeared four years after we broke up.   

With the same devastatingly handsome, sly face as before.   
To make matters worse, he showed up as a 5-billion-won investor who could save our company, so I couldn't just coldly turn him away.    

That was how it all began.   

"I'm not letting you go. If you can't be mine, I won't let anyone else have you."  

At work, we pretend to be nothing more than colleagues, but in secret, we share a covert intimate partnership.  

If I keep getting shaken by him crossing the line...    

It's only because my ex is too sexy; that's all!
